facts.value: Chinese Course 1
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: This course consists of 4 classes, starting with a course for beginners with no prior knowledge. The goal is to acquire basic vocabulary and solidify knowledge about the basic structures of the Chinese language. After this course, students should be able to conduct simple dialogues in Chinese and independently handle typical situations in everyday life as well as in tourist and professional/business stays in China. They will acquire linguistic and intercultural skills as well as knowledge about the culture and society of China, which is beneficial for activities in Chinese-German economic relations and establishing and maintaining contacts with Chinese partners.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: The reading comprehension and writing competence will be tested in the form of a 90-minute examination in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate will be issued for passing the exam.
